title: Ground-state condensation in the dilute hard-sphere gas
summary: We prove Bose–Einstein condensation in every ground state of a dilute three-dimensional hard-sphere Bose gas. At every sufficiently small fixed gas parameter, the constant orbital contains a positive fraction of the particles in the thermodynamic limit. The fraction can be chosen independently of the gas parameter, and the conclusion holds for arbitrary complex ground states.
family_title: Positive-temperature Bose–Einstein condensation and exact quantum depletion
